events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: September 1st marks 30 years since the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away days later.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Three decades on, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture is still undeniable. What's your favourite track from the legendary artist?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Anniversary of His Passing
events.blurb: September 2nd marks the anniversary of the death of rock guitar legend Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Remembering a Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today. His guitar work changed music forever. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Turns 57
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's an absolute masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman and rock icon Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 51
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The iPod at 25
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25 today! It changed everything for music lovers. What was the first song you put on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Grab your martini, it's time to celebrate 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: Anniversary of His Passing
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – a pivotal album that pushed their sound in new directions. A true classic.

events.title: John Lennon: Anniversary of His Death
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world.
